bio:
I’m studying for an M.S. Engineering at San José State University. My current work includes a driving-detection evaluation and a scene-memory pilot: if an object is no longer detected, how can another view help distinguish removal from occlusion?

At Canonical, I deployed OpenStack, Kubernetes, and Ceph private clouds and diagnosed failures across Linux and networking. Working with customers also meant explaining why a system failed and deciding what to test next.

I started in security at UC Santa Cruz through the Slug Security Club, then worked on cloud compliance, threat modeling, and automation. I still use my homelab to rebuild systems and reproduce problems.

My longer-term interests include robots that keep useful memories of shared spaces, and autonomous systems for space exploration.

headline: M.S. Engineering student at SJSU
introduction: I’m an M.S. Engineering student at SJSU working on visual perception. My current projects examine how evaluation settings change detector comparisons and how to tell an occluded object from one that has been removed. Before SJSU, I deployed and troubleshot private clouds at Canonical.
name: Adithya Rajendran

timeline.title: M.S. Engineering (Interdisciplinary)

highlights: Led customer engagements from discovery and architecture through multi-rack OpenStack, Kubernetes, and Ceph private-cloud deployments, including erasure-coded Ceph.
Led a multi-site MAAS bare-metal rollout, advancing sites in parallel around blockers and teaching the process through a customer working session.
Diagnosed failures across Linux kernels, networking, switch configuration, and applications; provided bug fixes and documented root causes.
Automated deployments and operations with Python, Terraform, and Bash; created CIS and DISA STIG tailoring files and mapped controls to fleet-management tools.
Led technical presales and tailored OpenStack and MicroCloud demonstrations; drafted statements of work and mentored new field engineers.
Presented product demos to Forrester and Gartner analysts; co-presented SQL Server on Ubuntu with Microsoft at PASS Data Community Summit 2024.
timeline.summary: Systems engineering, customer problem-solving, and technical communication across private-cloud deployments.
timeline.title: Field Software Engineer I (promoted from Associate Field Engineer after the first year)

highlights: Identified gaps between cloud-provider configurations and compliance requirements through fit-gap analysis.
Used MITRE ATT&CK to structure threat modeling and prioritize remediation.
Built Python automation and JavaScript demonstrations to reduce repetitive work and explain compliance requirements.
Implemented authentication and authorization with Auth0; applied least-privilege access and network segmentation.
Presented “Navigating AI Risks for Small Businesses” at IGNITE and Bucknell University conferences; explained security findings through reports and visualizations.
